A matching lower bound for linear swap regret √ Finally, we construct an adaptive adversary that forces any learner to incur Ω(d T ) linear swap regret in expectation. We show this even when P is centrally symmetric, matching Theorem 15. Our lower bound also implies that the algorithm of Gordon et al. (2008) is existential optimal algorithm for minimizing linear swap regret (with or without central symmetry) in view of Proposition 3. To put this into context, we recall that for the simplex P = ∆d , the most well-studied √ strategy set in the context of minimizing swap regret, there are algorithms that guarantee O( T d log d) (linear) swap regret (Blum and Mansour, 2007), so our lower bound establishes a strict separation.
